items: After an update, this box lists what changed since the version you had.
ShotRef's messages (updates, About, file errors) now look like ShotRef and open without the Windows alert sound.
A quick tour of the screen: orange viewfinder corners frame each part, with a line or two on each. It changes nothing in your scene.
Take the tour again any time from the Help menu or the top of the Quick start page.
Editor, Top and Camera (and split view) moved into a View group in the row under the picture, so the top bar is cleaner.
The Windows app updates itself: it checks for a new version shortly after launch and asks before downloading or restarting.
Help, Check for updates checks on demand. Help, Check for updates automatically turns the launch check off.
